临时休整的营火。按交互键休息一次，回复 20% 生命上限并驱散寒冷。旁边的冲淋装: The Safe House campfire. Press interact to rest once: recover 20% of max HP and shake off the cold. The shower beside it lowers contamination.
层中必有一层设有撤离信标；第 10 层是前哨据点（每 20 层是首领战场），之后: , one floor always has an extraction beacon. Floor 10 is the Outpost (every 20th, a Boss Arena), then the camp, with a fixed extraction point and Closure's supplies.
每 10 层是一张路线图，每一列是一层。只看得清下一层；再下一层只显示是作战还是: Every 10 floors are one route map, one column per floor. Only the next floor is clear; the one after shows only fight or encounter, and further on only beacons and contract targets. Each node holds something different; pick one and press Proceed.
每十层的第 4–6 层中，必有一层设有撤离信标。: In every ten floors, one of floors 4–6 has an extraction beacon.
沿道路寻找深入入口，按交互键打开路线图，选择下一层的去向。越往深处，敌人越强，收: Follow the road to a way down and press interact to open the route map and pick the next floor. The deeper you go, the stronger the enemies and the better the spoils.
诡异行商坎诺特，只在路线图上的“诡异行商”节点出现。可以用赤金购买藏品、装备与药: Cannot the Rogue Trader, found only at Rogue Trader nodes on the route map. Buy relics, gear and potions with Pure Gold, or sell items to him; his shelves can be refreshed for a fee.
路线图只看得清下一层，情报部的路线测绘能多看一层。: The route map shows only the next floor clearly; Intelligence's Route Survey shows one more.
这一层有一件不期而遇的事。走近按交互键查看，每个选择都写明代价与收获；也可以不理: Something unexpected waits on this floor. Walk up and press interact; every choice states its cost and gain. You may also ignore it and move on.
这是通往下一层的入口，每条路线一个，颜色对应下一层的节点。按交互键打开路线图选择: A way down to the next floor, one per route, coloured like the node it leads to. Press interact to open the route map and choose.
